method: Most recent successful completed CI runs among first 100 listed, up to 30 pull requests and 25 pushes, selected separately. Execution data read by CI test invocation ID from GitHub log. No population weighting, retries or failed runs. Ten reads failed, eleven replies had no fresh TestRunner actions; no action does not prove no tests selected or cached. NEW TestRunner executionStart to executionCompleted action process intervals only. Actions may include more than one physical action per target/invocation; process seconds are additive worker work, not elapsed CI feedback.
